column5: Look: PS1-style low-poly 3D at a low internal resolution scaled up with hard pixels, vertex wobble, ordered dithering and distance fog. Pine-green bank, blue-grey misty water, warm amber sun tint that shifts through the day; chunky early-2000s HUD. Signature detail: tree shadows sliding across the water as the sun moves. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
References: Rapala Pro Bass Fishing (the "TV broadcast" catch banner), BioShock 2 (the needle gauge).
View: 3D · Camera: first person from the kayak seat.

You start in the kayak at the dock at sunrise.
Paddle toward a patch of shade under the pines, hold Space, and cast.
A cast on open water bites in about 5 s; in shade, about 2 s.
FISH ON flashes red; hit Space inside 1.5 s, then stop the needle on green three times as the text turns green.
Rainbow flash, broadcast banner: your first Pumpkinseed.
Commons are easy.

The first real trouble comes around minutes 3–5: your first Reggie opens the Uncommons, whose needle is faster with smaller zones, and each hit pushes Hunger toward Munchies, which locks fishing and smoking until you eat.
The Legendary takes a few tries.
A loss costs the fish and the weed you burned to reach it.
